description: Fashion Disaster is a Roblox dress-up survival game: build an outfit, then try to survive floods, fires and other disasters on the runway. Codes unlock free clothing, hairstyles and accessories for your closet.
redeemSteps: Click the Settings button at the top left of the screen.
Paste the code into the "Input code here" box.
Click "Redeem!". The item appears in your closet straight away.
